events.text: Mary Thomas took up work as a barmaid again after returning to Perth.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After returning to Perth in 1911 Mary Thomas took up work as a barmaid again

events.text: She bought her first business, the Bon Ton Cafe on William Street.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1915 she bought her first business , the Bon Ton Cafe on William Street

events.text: She ran the Bon Ton Cafe for eight years.
events.subject: self
